column1: # PTX spill ratchet — tools/ptx-spill-check.sh (recipe `just gate-ptx-spill`) holds every entry of
# these binaries to the spill and jit_local bytes pinned here: `spill` is ptxas's spill stores
# (bytes), `jit_local` the driver JIT's local bytes per thread (tools/ptx-scan.sh's columns). The
# check is exact: a value above its pin, below it, an entry the scan prints that has no row, and a
# row whose entry the scan no longer prints are each a failure. A nonzero pin carries a PIN line.
# Pinned from the scans on ptxas 13.3.73, sm_86, JIT on the RTX 3090 with CUDA 13.4.

# PIN(2026-09-25): ds41_attn_seg_stage is the staged prefix segment pass (prefill only, never on the decode path); its ring ⧺ staging source keeps a few registers more than ds41_attn_seg, which already sits at the 128-register cap of a 512-thread block, and ptxas spills 8 bytes. ds41_attn_seg_sel_stage fits in 112 with none.

# PIN(2026-09-24): flash_latent_seg_v2 is the TWICE_V probe entry (probe_cfg.flash_v2); its second V pass compiles to a small local spill at the shipped entry's two blocks per SM, which its doc names as the point of the arm.

# PIN(2026-09-24): flash_merge2_q8 is the probe twin of merge_row (runs only under probe_cfg.flash_merge2); its 16-segment merge batch keeps 40 bytes of ptxas spill and 8 of JIT local. MERGE_BATCH stays: the shipped merge carries no spill.
